name.description: The PureQL type name; for a list parameter, the list type name, such as stringList.

nullable.description: True for the type of a typed null; false for the type of a value and for a list type.

IParameterType.description: The PureQL type of a bound query parameter: the counterpart of the type of a PureQL literal.

value.description: The bound value as invariant cell text, such as -42, 1.5, True, 2026-10-29, 08:30:00, 2026-10-29T08:30:00 or a lower case uuid; the empty string for a typed null. For a list parameter, a JSON array of its items' values, such as ["paid","shipped"].

items.description: The items of a list parameter, in order: parameters of the item type that hold a value. A parameter that is not a list has no items.

IParameter.description: The value bound to a query parameter: the counterpart of a PureQL literal. A list parameter also has its items.

value.description: The bound value as invariant cell text, such as -42, 1.5, True, 2026-10-29, 08:30:00, 2026-10-29T08:30:00 or a lower case uuid; the empty string for a typed null. For a list parameter, a JSON array of its items' values, such as ["paid","shipped"].

items.description: The items of a list parameter, in order: parameters of the item type that hold a value. A parameter that is not a list has no items.

IListParameter.description: The list bound to a list parameter, read by in: the counterpart of a PureQL list literal, with its items as parameters of the item type.
